en.headline: FEHD reminds public to check restaurant permits before taking dogs out for Halloween meals
en.dek: The department said more than 990 restaurants currently hold permission for dogs, and both operators and owners must follow leash and other rules.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department reminded the public on Sunday that anyone planning to take a dog to a restaurant for Halloween should first confirm the premises is permitted to admit dogs and comply with the rules.

An FEHD spokesman said more than 990 restaurants currently hold the permission. Operators must ensure licensing conditions are met and staff remind customers; dog owners must keep animals on a leash of no more than 1.5 metres held by an adult or secured to a fixture.
The department said it would continue risk-based inspections and enforcement. Bringing a dog into a non-permitted restaurant is an offence for both the customer and the operator.

zh.headline: 食環署提醒市民萬聖節外出用膳前確認食肆是否准許狗隻進入
zh.dek: 署方指目前逾990間食肆獲准容許狗隻，經營者及主人須遵守牽繩等規定。
body: 食物環境衞生署周日提醒市民，如計劃萬聖節期間帶狗隻外出用膳，應先確認該食肆是否獲准容許狗隻進入，並遵守相關法例。
食環署發言人表示，目前逾990間食肆持有相關准許。經營者須確保符合牌照條件並提醒顧客；狗主必須由成年人以不超過1.5米的牽繩穩妥牽引，或將狗隻穩妥繫於固定物。
署方會繼續按風險進行巡查及執法。將狗隻帶入非獲准食肆，顧客及經營者均屬違法。
